code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(a) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if a[r0][c]==bg:a[r0][c]=2
        if a[r1][c]==bg:a[r1][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if a[r][c0]==bg:a[r][c0]=2
        if a[r][c1]==bg:a[r][c1]=2
    return a
''';p.write_text(code)
